panels.title: Session Border Controller (SBCE) Diagnostics & Perimeter Security
SNMPv3 Status
panels.description: Operational status of the SNMPv3 monitoring agent on the Avaya Session Border Controller Enterprise (SBCE 8.1). Value 1 indicates SNMP daemon is responding to polling requests; 0 indicates SNMP agent timeout or unreachable. Source: Zabbix SNMPv3 agent ping. Limitations: Verifies management plane reachability only; does not confirm media proxy or SIP signaling functionality. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: System Uptime
panels.description: Elapsed time since last reboot of the Avaya SBCE operating system (CentOS-based SBC OS). Units: Seconds (formatted as days, hours, minutes). Source: HOST-RESOURCES-MIB::hrSystemUptime (OID .1.3.6.1.2.1.25.1.1.0). Limitations: A sudden drop to zero indicates an unplanned reboot or power disruption. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: CPU Utilization
panels.description: Total processor utilization across all cores of the Avaya SBCE appliance. Units: Percentage (0–100%). Warning threshold: 75%, Critical: 90%. Source: HOST-RESOURCES-MIB::hrProcessorLoad (OID .1.3.6.1.2.1.25.3.3.1.2). Limitations: High CPU may cause delayed SIP transaction processing and audio transcoding artifacts. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: RAM Utilization
panels.description: Percentage of physical memory currently consumed on the Avaya SBCE. Units: Percentage (0–100%). Source: HOST-RESOURCES-MIB memory allocation metrics. Warning: 80%, Critical: 95%. Limitations: Memory exhaustion can lead to Linux OOM killer terminating SIP signaling processes. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: Root Disk Utilization
panels.description: Disk space consumption on the root (/) filesystem partition of the Avaya SBCE appliance. Units: Percentage (0–100%). Source: HOST-RESOURCES-MIB::hrStorageUsed (OID .1.3.6.1.2.1.25.2.3.1.6). Limitations: Log file accumulation (e.g., trace_sbc) can fill disk, leading to packet capture failure or service halt. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: Load Average (1m)
panels.description: One-minute system load average representing the number of runnable or waiting processes. Units: Scalar load average. Source: UCD-SNMP-MIB::laLoad.1 (OID .1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.10.1.3.1). Limitations: Sustained load higher than CPU core count indicates queue saturation and potential SIP packet drop. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: A1 — External DMZ (SIP Signaling)
panels.description: Link operational status of physical interface A1 connecting the Avaya SBCE to the external DMZ and telecom service provider SIP trunks (e.g., Safaricom). 1 = Up, 2 = Down. Source: IF-MIB::ifOperStatus.1. Limitations: Down status causes immediate loss of external inbound/outbound telephony. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: B1 — Internal Media & Core Signaling
panels.description: Link operational status of physical interface B1 connecting the Avaya SBCE to the internal core voice network (Avaya Aura Session Manager & Media Gateways). 1 = Up, 2 = Down. Source: IF-MIB::ifOperStatus.2. Limitations: Down status halts internal call routing between SBCE and Aura Core. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: M1 — Primary Management
panels.description: Link operational status of interface M1 dedicated to out-of-band management and EMS web administration. 1 = Up, 2 = Down. Source: IF-MIB::ifOperStatus.3. Limitations: Interface failure prevents administrative access and EMS configuration synchronization but does not disrupt active call traffic. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: M2 — Secondary / HA Heartbeat
panels.description: Link operational status of interface M2 used for High Availability (HA) clustering heartbeat and state synchronization between SBCE primary and standby appliances. 1 = Up, 2 = Down. Source: IF-MIB::ifOperStatus.4. Limitations: Loss of M2 heartbeat can trigger split-brain condition or disable automatic failover. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: A1 Carrier DMZ Traffic (bps)
panels.description: Bidirectional network bandwidth utilization on external interface A1 carrying carrier SIP signaling (UDP/TCP/TLS 5060/5061) and RTP media streams. Units: Bits per second (bps) with delta rate calculation. Source: IF-MIB::ifHCInOctets / ifHCOutOctets. Limitations: Polled at 30s intervals; short microbursts below polling window are smoothed. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: B1 Internal Media & Core Signaling Traffic (bps)
panels.description: Bidirectional network throughput on internal interface B1 carrying media streams between SBCE and Avaya Media Servers/Gateways. Units: Bits per second (bps). Source: IF-MIB::ifHCInOctets / ifHCOutOctets. Limitations: Bandwidth spikes correlate with concurrent active RTP call sessions. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: Voice Path Packet Errors (rate)
panels.description: Rate of inbound and outbound frame/packet errors detected on voice-bearing interfaces (A1 and B1). Units: Errors per second. Source: IF-MIB::ifInErrors / ifOutErrors. Limitations: Any non-zero error rate directly degrades voice audio quality, causing robotic voice, clipping, and clicks. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: Voice Path Packet Discards (rate)
panels.description: Rate of dropped inbound and outbound packets due to buffer overrun or NIC queue saturation on voice interfaces A1 and B1. Units: Packets per second (pps). Source: IF-MIB::ifInDiscards / ifOutDiscards. Limitations: Non-zero discards indicate interface or switch buffer congestion requiring QoS review. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.title: Avaya SBCE Active Alarms & Problems Feed
panels.description: Live real-time alarm stream of active operational problems and threshold violations originating from Avaya SBCE hosts in Zabbix. Source: Zabbix Problems API filtered for Avaya SBCE host group. Limitations: Reflected alarms depend on Zabbix trigger definitions and polling intervals. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.description: Total active alarm conditions on Communication Manager. Source: Avaya CM 8.1 MIB table avCmAlarmsTable (group OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.5). Polling interval: strictly 1 hour (delay: 1h) to prevent excessive CPU consumption on the CM call engine. Freshness: 1-2 hours. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.description: Call processing activity indicator from Avaya CM 8.1 MIB avCmListMeasCallRateTotalTable (group OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.145). Polling interval: strictly 5 minutes (vendor rate-limiting bound). Note: measurement interval is an hourly measurement block from list measurements call-rate total, not a rolling 5-minute counter. Attempts is not exposed as a 5-minute counter in this table. Missing data indicates collector timeout or SNMP failure.

Source: Avaya CM 8.1 MIB table avCmListMeasCallRateTotalTable (group OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.145 leaf .1.3.1). Polling interval: strictly 5 minutes (vendor engine protection limit). Measurement interval: hourly measurement block. Missing data indicates CM SNMP communication outage.

panels.description: Percentage of IP voice audio packets lost during active calls in the last completed hour across the monitored network region. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67 leaf .10). Polling interval: strictly 1 hour. Caching interval: 600s. Warning: > 1.0%, Critical: > 2.5%. Missing data indicates CM SNMP communication outage or unadministered IP options.
panels.title: Real-Call Packet Loss % (Last Hour) [REAL — AVAYA SNMP]

panels.description: Peak interarrival packet jitter in milliseconds observed across real calls in the last completed hour. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67 leaf .11). Polling interval: strictly 1 hour. Caching interval: 600s. Warning: > 20ms, Critical: > 30ms. Missing data indicates collector outage.
panels.title: Real-Call Peak Jitter (Last Hour) [REAL — AVAYA SNMP]

panels.description: Maximum two-way round-trip audio packet delay in milliseconds observed across real calls in the last completed hour. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67 leaf .12). Polling interval: strictly 1 hour. Caching interval: 600s. Target: <= 150ms (ITU-T G.114), Critical: > 250ms. Missing data indicates collector outage.
panels.title: Real-Call Peak Delay (Last Hour) [REAL — AVAYA SNMP]

panels.description: Summary interarrival packet jitter metric calculated across active calls in the completed hour. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67). Polling interval: strictly 1 hour. Caching interval: 600s. Missing data indicates collector outage.
panels.title: Hourly Average Jitter [REAL — AVAYA SNMP]

panels.description: Primary negotiated audio compression algorithm / codec (e.g. G.711A, G.711U, G.729) active in the measured network region. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67 leaf .8). Polling interval: 1 hour. Missing data indicates collector outage.
panels.title: Negotiated Audio Codec [REAL — AVAYA SNMP]

panels.description: Operational status of hardware/software echo cancellation on voice paths for the measured network region. Source: Avaya CM SNMP table avCmMeasIpVoStatHrData (OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.6889.2.73.8.1.67 leaf .13). Polling interval: 1 hour. Missing data indicates collector outage.

panels.description: Registration status of the G450 Media Gateway with its controlling Avaya Communication Manager server. 1 = REGISTERED, 2 = UNREGISTERED, 3 = DISCOVERING. Source: Avaya G450 Gateway MIB. Polling: 60s. Critical alert if unregistered. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.

panels.description: Event-derived internal thermal state of the G450 chassis processor. States: 0 = UNKNOWN (no trap received / initialized), 1 = CLEARED (normal operation after temperatureClear trap), 2 = WARNING (ambient temperature threshold exceeded after temperatureWarning trap). Important: Avaya G450 MGP firmware does not expose a continuous analog temperature gauge or a separate critical trap state; thermal monitoring is strictly event-derived (Phase 13.3 MIB conformance). Provenance: CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED. Missing data indicates trapper service failure.
panels.title: Chassis Thermal State [EVENT TRAP — G450 MGP]

panels.description: Operational state of Primary and Redundant Power Supply Units (PSU 1 and PSU 2). 1 = Normal, 2 = Fault/Failed, 3 = Not Installed. Collection Mechanism: Ingested via G450 MGP SNMP traps (powerSupplyFailure / powerSupplyNormal) or chassis status. Provenance: CONFIGURED_UNVERIFIED. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.
panels.title: Power Supply Status (PSU 1 & 2) [CONFIGURED — EVENT TRAP]

panels.description: Operational link status of the physical E1 / ISDN PRI trunk port on the installed MM710 media module. 1 = UP, 2 = DOWN. Source: IF-MIB ifOperStatus. Polling: 60s. Critical alert if down. Missing data indicates collector outage, agent failure, or network disruption; values are preserved as null gaps.
